description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Delaware Code -- Delaware state law -- by citation. "11-636" is murder in the first degree; "6-2734" is contracts with automatic renewal provisions. Accepts natural forms: "11-636", "11 Del. C. § 636", "Title 11 § 636". Returns the current statutory text, the official catchline, chapter/subchapter/title context, and the AMENDMENT HISTORY (the session-law citation chain Delaware prints at the end of every section). Delaware publishes the CURRENT text only -- no per-year historical archive; this tool says so rather than guessing. Keyless. Use for "what does 11 Del. C. 636 say" or to check a Delaware statute a case or lease relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, title-section, e.g. "11-636" (murder in the first degree) or "6-2734" (automatic-renewal contracts). Some sections carry a letter suffix, e.g. "11-607A".
